about_the_game:
Silent Chamber is a first-person psychological horror adventure about stealth, survival, and the search for lost relics hidden within nightmarish locations and ancient depths.

Play as Kate, a woman bound by a dark bargain that leads her into places no living soul should ever tread.

STORYLINE

In return for supernatural favors, Kate must recover forbidden relics concealed within abandoned estates and forgotten buildings—each containing an ancient magic sought by a dark wizard for reasons he keeps secret.

Her search eventually leads her beneath the surface, into a hellish underworld where something precious waits to be saved. But nothing there is what it seems, and Kate soon realizes that no one returns from this place unchanged.

GAMEPLAY

Explore haunted environments, uncover cryptic clues, and solve puzzles tied to lost rituals.
Use stealth and sound to survive what hunts in the dark — every step, every breath, can give you away.
Collect relics, read forgotten journals, and uncover the dark history of the places you explore and the people (and things) who inhabit them.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

  • Traverse dark, oppressive environments filled with occult symbols, ancient ruins, and forbidden rituals.

  • Encounter mysterious and unsettling characters, each with their own motives and hidden truths.

  • Face ferocious monsters, demonic entities, and terrifying mimics lurking in the shadows.

  • Uncover old rivalries between powerful wizards and the forces they once tried to control.

  • Experience a world steeped in decay, dread, and the lingering presence of something watching.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror themes, frightening imagery, blood, and depictions of bones and corpses. Certain scenes include veiled non-sexual nudity in the form of a ghostly apparition. It also features references to alcohol and tobacco use and disturbing supernatural content that may not be suitable for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6 GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 Ti (8 GB+) / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (16 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure where survival depends on silence and stealth. Explore cursed places, uncover lost relics, and navigate a decaying underworld of ancient chambers. Every step echoes, and fear has no exit.
